about_the_game:
Hypercycle League isn't just a race; it’s a high-stakes game of physical chess played at 300mph. Designed for the elite, this is the definitive evolution of light-trail combat.

### Your Trail is Your Weapon In the League, you don’t just drive—you dominate space. Use tactical geometry to deny zones, trap rivals in precision webs, and force your opponents into a dead end.

  • Pure Skill: No luck. Your reflexes are your only armor.

  • Elite Coordination: From 1v1 duels to sanctioned 4v4 team wars.

  • Frame-Perfect Tech: Built for the highest level of competitive play.

### Ascend the Ranks Climb the global leaderboard and compete in sanctioned tournaments. In this arena, every pixel is a battlefield, and every second counts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: no
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: no

short_description: Cut the line. Own the neon. Hypercycle League is a high-octane evolution of light-trail combat where milliseconds are the difference between glory and a data-crash. No RNG, no gimmicks—just pure, frame-perfect digital athleticism. Are you fast enough to leave a mark?"
